name: Red-headed agama
desc: Red-headed agama (Agama picticauda): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 187 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Agama picticauda, also known commonly as Peters's rock agama and the African redhead agama, is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is native to West Africa.
